verdict.rationale: Auth0's AI docs state that agents can use CIBA to request asynchronous human approval for sensitive operations via push, SMS, or email, even when the user is not actively using the app, and they list 'human-in-the-loop controls with CIBA' as a core agent-security feature. Separately, Strong Customer Authentication with Dynamic Linking binds transaction details to the approval. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed first-party implementation docs (e.g. approval-binding specifics and timeout/denial handling for agent flows).
